投稿者: Maria Alejandra コロンビアのOperation Supervisor 認証済みLinkedInユーザー アウトソーシング、オフショア, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "The best phone app"
良い点: It is a friendly and easy-to-use application, which allows direct communication with people outside, and above all, it offers multiple forms of communication, from voice messages, text messages, or direct communication with people.
改善点: that in order to access the purchase there is a lot of protocol and one must be contacted by a sales agent instead of being able to call to request the license purchase service.

投稿者: David アメリカのPresident 事務用品、事務機器, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Very Powerful and complete"
良い点: Currently, one of the best features of Goto Connect is the new AI feature. It allows an AI receptionist for very reasonable rates. It has all the other standard features you expect from a VOIP provider and the pricing is very reasonable. ALSO, the quality is ALWAYS perfect. Another great feature is the outgoing VM message can be typed in and it will create a very high quality computer generated voice to play.
改善点: The learning curve for Goto Connect can be a little steep. Not that it is difficult, there are just a lot of options you can use. There are lots of video tutorials to get you through it.

タイトル: WE DO NOT RECOMMEND!!! WHAT A TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE.
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費者サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "WE DO NOT RECOMMEND!!! WHAT A TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE."
良い点: ABSOLUTELY AWFUL EXPERIENCE!!!! We are two weeks in and searching for something else. There is absolutely NOTHING that we liked about GoToConnect. They sold us on something that didnt work, sold us the wrong amount of licenses, and then support continually told us "we will get it fixed after we hang up" to do absolutely NOTHING after. We show up the next day and the phones still dont work, there's no response, no communication back to us, and no actual help after spending hours on the phone the previous day. WE DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!
改善点: ABSOLUTELY AWFUL EXPERIENCE!!!! We are two weeks in and we have spent 30 hours trying to get anything to work. We are missing calls for days. We are a simple, small business with just 2 locations, 4 phones, 2 managers, and over and over support couldn't get it right and then our CSM spent days fixing it for it to break over and over. WE WILL NEVER BE BACK. WE DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!!

タイトル: Optimization-driven tool with extremely good support and service.
投稿者: Gianna アメリカのAccounting and Finance 飲食店, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Optimization-driven tool with extremely good support and service."
良い点: The support from customer support managers and support staff, and the fact that the tool is extremely future-oriented and constantly releases new features that create absolute added value, especially in customer communication and sales. We often use this tool to work on optimizing our strategy, understanding our client's needs better and helping us become more efficient in our tasks.
改善点: I've noticed only two negative aspects of GoTo Connect. Firstly, calls sometimes fail to connect. This is obviously inconvenient when speaking with customers. Secondly, assigned calls are often not found in the 'To Do's' list.

投稿者: Shane アメリカのowner-CEO 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "goto connect"
良い点: Ease of use with consolidated services. They have good phone & customer support with quick results. Their pricing structure is good.
改善点: The initial set up was a bit confusing and trying to navigate their bubble system when routing calls is confusing.

タイトル: Reachable everywhere with just one number
投稿者: Oliver ドイツのCFO 薬品, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Reachable everywhere with just one number"
良い点: Offers the essential functions we need in our business context and also provides exciting features we haven't used before. Inquiries are answered the same day, even by phone. We've rarely experienced such a a good onboarding process.
改善点: So far, we have not been able to identify any negative aspects and are pleased to have discovered GoTo Connect.

投稿者: LaWanda アメリカのConcierge Representative 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "GoTo phone app"
良い点: I like that I can take my extension with me as I go from office to remotely at home, and that I can use the app, should I not have my laptop available.
改善点: It stinks that if the internet connection goes out, then I have no access to my extension, and that if I am at home, and someone is in the office and needs a phone, they cannot use the physical phone at my desk if I'm logged in at home.

投稿者: Cindy アメリカのLaw Clerk 弁護士業界, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great Product"
良い点: Reliable cloud phone and UCaaS platform Strong call quality and uptime Easy mobile and desktop apps Helpful customer support Rich feature set, including AI receptionist, SMS, video meetings, and integrations
改善点: Initial setup and call routing can have a learning curve Some users report occasional call quality or connectivity issues Complex administration for advanced configurations Mixed experiences with support after onboarding for some organizations

投稿者: Ian アメリカのUndisclosed 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Worst customer experience EVER"
良い点: GoTo Connect is hands down the most useless, dishonest company I’ve ever dealt with. They couldn’t even manage to set up my account or activate my service, yet they were lightning-fast to charge my credit card for something I couldn’t use. No welcome call, no setup, no access — nothing but bills. When I tried to cancel, they hid behind some bogus “contract” even though I never once had a working account. They literally told me they were going to keep charging me for a service that never existed. Unreal.
改善点: Their support team is a black hole of incompetence — endless hold times, scripted apologies, and zero actual help. Every “manager” promises to call you back, but none of them ever do. The only way I finally stopped the bleeding was by canceling my card so they couldn’t keep stealing from me.

投稿者: Makaiya アメリカのService and Construction Admin 建設, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "GoTo - The 21st Century Landline!"
良い点: We really like the ability to filter calls based on the kind of customer assistance needed. GoTo also shows us who is calling and it is almost always accurate.
改善点: The main thing I don't like, is not having the ability to send a message to a phone number that is not in your contacts. You have to call the person back, or wait for them to call you back. Also, many people do not listen to the whole prompt, they just choose the first name that is said.

投稿者: Daniel 英国のIT Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Better options on the market"
良い点: The user interface is very easy to navigate. It is very reliable little to no down time from recvied by myself and the people I support
改善点: Costs are not very competitie compared to other software on the market. Intergration is lacking compared to other vendors e.g. teams

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ファシリティサービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：GetApp 共有 "Péssima experiência"
良い点: Péssima experiência, demora para configurarem o software, cobrança abusiva de multa de cancelamento, na venda me falaram que não haveria e agora me mandaram boleto de quase mil reais. Muita morosidadde na resolução dos problemas, não recomendo a ninguém
改善点: Atendimento extremamente lento, equipe sem sincronia, um fala uma coisa e outro fala outra e muita morosidade na resolução de problemas.

投稿者: Alex カナダのSystems Analysis 建設, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Reliable VoIP Phone System"
良い点: Feature rich phone system that provides everything our business needs and more to allow our employees to make and receive calls. The auto attendant has allowed us to free up our document control personals time for more important matters than answering phone calls. Hard phones and soft phones work together seamlessly and offer our employees options on how they would like to receive calls.
改善点: The only negative I've experienced is that the SMS feature of the soft phones is unreliable. I've notice there is only about a 50% chance that any text message sent will be received. Particularly text verification (MFA) services don't seem to be received with the reliability that they would require.

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 石油、エネルギー, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Easy remote access tool"
良い点: All-in-one communication solution: GoToConnect combines voice, video, and chat capabilities in a single platform. This can help to streamline communication and make it easier for users to access all communication channels from one place.Ease of use: GoToConnect is designed to be user-friendly, with an intuitive interface that makes it easy for users to set up and manage their communication channels. This can help to reduce the learning curve and minimize the need for technical expertise.Scalability: GoToConnect can scale up or down as per business needs, making it a suitable solution for small, medium and large organizations. This can help businesses to grow without worrying about outgrowing their communication solution.Integration: GoToConnect integrates with a range of popular business tools, including CRMs, helpdesk systems, and productivity software. This can help to streamline workflows and improve efficiency.Mobility: GoToConnect is accessible from anywhere with an internet connection, making it ideal for remote work or for businesses with employees who are frequently on-the-go.Cost-effective: GoToConnect offers a range of pricing plans to suit different business needs and budgets. The platform also has no hidden fees, allowing businesses to budget for communication costs more effectively.
改善点: Reliance on internet connectivity: GoToConnect is a cloud-based solution, which means that users need a stable internet connection to use it. If the internet connection is unstable or slow, the quality of voice and video calls can suffer.Limited customization: While GoToConnect is highly functional, it may not be as customizable as some other solutions on the market. This could be an issue for businesses with highly specific requirements or for businesses that want to integrate with specialized software.Limited analytics: GoToConnect does not provide in-depth analytics and reporting features. This can make it difficult for businesses to track call quality, user activity, and other key performance metrics.Training and adoption: GoToConnect may require some training for users to fully understand how to use all of its features. This can be a challenge for businesses with employees who are not tech-savvy or resistant to change.High-volume usage: GoToConnect may not be the best fit for businesses that have high-volume communication needs, such as call centers or large customer support teams. The platform may not have the necessary scalability or functionality to handle high-volume usage.

タイトル: Superior Customer Service and a Service to Match
投稿者: Jay アメリカのProject Manager 機械・産業工学, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Superior Customer Service and a Service to Match"
良い点: Disclaimer: we have only just started using GoToConnect. I will set a reminder for six months from now to reevaluate this review, but unless something drastic happens, I have nothing but praise. Starting out with the most impressive first, GoToConnect offers a dedicated onboarding team to assist with everything from receiving your hardware order, configuring the system to suit your business' needs, discovering features that you didn't even know you needed, all the way through porting your number from your previous provider and verifying that everything works as expected. I placed my order for service and hardware on Tuesday 8/10 and received the hardware on 8/11. I had the system mostly configured by Friday 8/13 and completely configured by the following Tuesday using a temporary number with the help of the onboarding team. The only problem was that there was a minimum 14 day wait period to port the number over that we needed to wait for in order to have the full service active! The service itself has been dependable and top quality with very clear audio and excellent usability.
改善点: The only downside that we have experienced so far is the intra-company messaging. It is only available on the desktop app and is not very dependable, requiring the use of a secondary messaging software such as Skype for messaging.

タイトル: The Best Service For Remote Call Centers
投稿者: Paul アメリカのManager 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "The Best Service For Remote Call Centers"
良い点: We use GoToConnect to manage remote agents and it is the best phone system we have ever had. Reporting is easy to gather. The ability to make administrative changes to the call system is the best in the industry. Hands down this is the best service we have ever used in 20+ years.
改善点: This software had no weaknesses at all. It is robust and provides every feature you could dream of.

投稿者: Matthewq アメリカのChief Clerk 政府機関, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Chief Clerk"
良い点: It has features which are very useful. 1. Monitoring individual user time and calls 2. Complete lists of incoming and outgoing calls to particular numbers 3. The easy ability to change the ring group from the receptionist to all users 4. Regular service updates on service issues
改善点: Nothing. It is exactly what we need and want

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー Eラーニング, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Jive Voice Value is Value"
良い点: This internet phone service allows you to have a landline at a low price and is customizable for your business.
改善点: The connection is not always good and the number that shows up on callers ID when you make an outbound call is different from the number people are calling.

投稿者: Chase アメリカのOutside Sales 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "My GoTo VoIP provider"
良い点: GoTo offers good voice quality as well as video conferencing. I have been using for almost 2 years now and have very rarely had issues like "robot voice" or the choppiness that you sometimes can get from a VoIP platform
改善点: While it is reliable most of the time, calls have gotten choppy in the past. This is rare however and happens less than once a month.

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "5yrs and still satisified"
良い点: feature rich for an exceptionally affordable service. allows a SMB to leverage capabilities that simulate larger scale company profiles. Positive interaction with reps and developers allows for valued evolution of the product to maintain pace with industry advancements. For a telecom background admin, the platform provides robust capabilities but rabbit holes are also a danger! Cloud provisioning allows easy admin from any location. Formerly week basic reporting just recently enhanced (in beta) and looking very promising. Improved mobile app allows for reliable out of office experience call management.
改善点: proprietary platform requires that some features are deployed using building blocks rather than one touch provisioning for some basic needs. That is as negative as it gets.

投稿者: chris カナダのPartner 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Poor choice of phone system"
良い点: Having an app on my cell phone so I can answer a customer's call when away from my desk.
改善点: Doesn't facilitate being able to have a live person answer a call when a customer calls a specific extension. ie- When [sensitive content hidden] isn't at his desk and someone calls him I want to pick up his calls.

投稿者: Allison アメリカのInsurance Broker 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 保険, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Office Phones"
良い点: I really like that my staff and I can take our phones home with us so we can work from home when the weather is bad. I also really love that if the phone isnt answered at my office it will ring on my personal cell.
改善点: I think it could be a little bit more user friendly but Im not the most tech savvy person.

投稿者: Kishor インドのBIM coordinator 情報技術、情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Cloud base Client Meetings"
良い点: It is the cloud base audio and video conferencing platform. It provides the screen share feature which help to easy communication and visual representation. We can easily setup or meeting and jump in meeting only by single click.
改善点: While doing video conferencing the background feature and themes are not good. Required to add more professional thems in background.

タイトル: Can't beat the pricing but does need some work
投稿者: Nalu アメリカのDirector Of Customer Success 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Can't beat the pricing but does need some work"
良い点: Pricing was very affordable. For our size of company and the growth we've experienced, the Jive staff has been great working with us to lock-in pricing and help us grow when more accounts are needed.
改善点: If you're calling through your computer or phone app, you will have a lot of dropped calls. Many of our reps use the app on the phone (or call through their computer) and report a horrible quality expereince and many dropped calls, with some switching to their old Google Voice number to complete the call. We've called Jive Support for help but the action taken has been very slow and to much avail.

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 通信, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Jive Support"
良い点: When I have a question, i can call, get through to a tech and get my question answered. They will log on and look at issues with me rather than just wanting to fix it and move on. They take time to make sure I understand what is going on and how to fix an issue. Jive engineers are the most responsive I have ever worked with.
改善点: It seems to be limited to specific programs written by Jive for Jive. Some features that are standard on some are not available on the Jive software. Their engineers are willing to work on solutions or work arounds.

投稿者: Blake カナダのMr 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Using Jive"
良い点: Lots of features. Once configured properly, it works very nicely and we have had few issues for production PBXes.
改善点: Lots of features - some of the management through the GUI to turn on or adjust features is unintuitive and probably unnecessarily so. Some of resolutions for issues seen during migrations to Jive took too long -- considering how critical regular phone service is for business, even now with all of the other communications tech options available.

投稿者: Dan アメリカのCOO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Welcome to the 21st Century"
良い点: Full featured yet clean interface. Easy to get familiar with. LOVE not having to have the PBX hardware on site.
改善点: The Chrome plugin is a little clunky. I go back and forth using it sometimes and disabling it for a while sometimes.

投稿者: chris アメリカのPartner エンタテインメント, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Jive Rocks!"
良い点: I love how fully featured the software is, its simplicity and reliability.
改善点: There are so many features it is simple to outthink yourself sometimes and make your all flows more complicated than they need to be. I do wish it integrated into our marketing automation software/CRM. Not really their fault, but would be nice not to manually log call anymore.

タイトル: Great VoIP service with just a few tiny kinks that could be worked out!
投稿者: Carleen アメリカのHead of Operations 保険, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great VoIP service with just a few tiny kinks that could be worked out!"
良い点: It's super easy to use. Onboarding was easy (at first the rep wouldn't contact us and we had to chase someone down to help with onboarding), but overall they are kind and try to assist. Everyone on the phones seems very in-tune with the online system for setup and programming. Very little downtime (if ever--it has yet to go down since we signed up which was many many months ago), and voice quality is great.
改善点: There are a LOT of "incompatible routers", which is difficult because our router is provided by Comcast and is for business use. If they have so many incompatible routers, I wish they'd provide a list of compatible ones (there isn't one--except for a bunch that Jive sells on their end that is impossible to get quickly). Customer service, though helpful, often times requires a "ticket" and then takes a long time to get back to us.

投稿者: Jeremy アメリカのDirector of Marketing 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great Customer Support"
良い点: The best thing I have found with this is being able to click on a number on my computer and it dials to my phone. It saves time and the frustration of accidentally dialing the wrong numbers.
改善点: I haven't experienced any real cons with the software yet.

投稿者: Megan アメリカのAdministration/Compliance Support 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Extremely user-friendly, excellent customer service"
良い点: The administration portal is extremely intuitive and user-friendly. I like the transparency and ability to control the interface remotely. Since our company transitioned to Jive eight months ago, it's been nothing but smooth sailing. The voice quality is superb, especially for our hard-of-hearing staff. Additionally, our small team of ten all report ease of use and preference over our previous voice provider.
改善点: When we initially signed our control, there was some issue with service interruption and our phone lines not working. It was short-lived because the customer service and our account rep worked immediately to remediate the issue, which ended up being an issue on our end (so nothing to do with Jive itself). Additionally, setting up an admin for the Jive Voice portal was a little challenging although everything ultimately worked out.

投稿者: Nicolle アメリカのAdministrator 非営利団体運営, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Good platform, not without fault"
良い点: I appreciate that the app is easy to use for the people on my team. The admin setup on the back end is relatively simple as well. Anything I've not been able to figure out on my own, I've received help from customer support.
改善点: The app is pretty regularly unreliable as it pertains to remaining on and logged in. I've had multiple days that calls began going directly to voicemail and I was only alerted to it by the voicemail notifications I received through email, otherwise I would have assumed it a slow call day.

タイトル: Good, efficient, saves me money but has issues
投稿者: Julie アメリカのHead of HR 電気・電子機器製造, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Good, efficient, saves me money but has issues"
良い点: Automated options are great. The eFax set up is great. I use it multiple times a week. I don’t have any problems with that. 24/7 customer service is helpful since I am Open everyday. I was able to save, per month on combining my 4 lines together.
改善点: Customer service needs more training. They did not know that an intercom option. Whenever I have an issue, sometimes after calling the customer service team, they fix it but can’t explain to me how they fixed it. Sometimes the reception is a little off for whatever reason because I have had customers call and can’t hear us or we can’t hear them. The dial plan needs work. I have so many lines and different auto attendants, it gets messy but the dial plan needs to light up between dial plans or something to identify the lines. It gets super confusing. Everything is connected via internet. If that’s down, I’m screwed.

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 医療業務, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "GREAT Customer Service"
良い点: All of the employees are super helpful, and the online portal is very easy to configure.
改善点: Wish it had more features and linked to our email.

投稿者: Jose Farmers Insurance Agent 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 保険, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Great service and customer support"
良い点: Even though I don't like to have to call tech support when I have issues, I do appreciate how knowledgeable and thorough technical support has been. Not only do they resolve my issue when I call they also follow up with me to ensure the problem didn't show up after.
改善点: Getting the phones setup took a bit of work. The online support is pretty good but having someone to walk you through helps a lot. I was on hold for quite a bit before I hung up and just started reading and ended up setting up my phones on my own.

投稿者: Margaret アメリカのParalegal 法律サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Reliable, Easy to Use"
良い点: Reliable, Easy to Use, and Customer Service is great if necesssary
改善点: Performance can sometimes be a problem, largely because of the internet service provider that you have. Otherwise largely reliable unless your internet goes down.

投稿者: Neal アメリカのProduction Specialist 印刷業, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Ain't no Jive"
良い点: Seamless integration. We switched from another service to Jive, the service is smooth and has great connectivity. Our voicemail settings and others switched with us.
改善点: It took about a month. We had to wait for our numbers to be transferred and sometimes calls wouldn't come through as they had. In the end it all worked out.

タイトル: The Voip solution that integrates with Zoho
投稿者: Stephen アメリカのBPO Facilitator 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "The Voip solution that integrates with Zoho"
良い点: It integrates with Zoho so that I can click to call and have a log of calls as well as take an incoming call and create a task on the fly.
改善点: It is so fully featured it took some tech support to get it set up but I consider that a plus in the event I need some tricked out features.

投稿者: Daniel アメリカのVice President of Acquisitions 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Nothing Lacking for the Price"
良い点: Jive Communication Systems is capable of doing everything a startup to mid-size sales company would expect (plus a whole lot more!) in terms of fielding inbound calls and placing high volume of outbound calls. Most importantly, the click-to-call feature is not considered an auto-dialer, giving that extra layer of protection and removing the chance of legal headaches that a startup or small business is ill-equipped to handle.
改善点: The one useful feature missing is the ability to spoof area codes without purchasing a corresponding phone number.

投稿者: Bob アメリカのOperations Mgr 建設, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Could be better"
良い点: It is able to be remote which in some cases works out well
改善点: There is a lot of lag. Like the signal sometimes is a few seconds behind

投稿者: marlene アメリカのsales mgr 自動車, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Jive Communication"
良い点: Jive Communication is one of the easiest communication software that I have seen. It is easy to login and make any changes that is necessary.
改善点: Sometimes it is a little bit difficult to navigate and figure out where some of the changes that might need to be made can be found.
